title: 3-Hour Rainforest Walk
summary: A guided 5 km walk through the Main Ridge rainforest with five waterfalls, hummingbird feeding and a local lunch.
body:
Enjoy a guided, low-intensity 5 km walk through the Tobago Main Ridge Forest Reserve, the world’s oldest protected rainforest reserve, recognised by UNESCO. It is an engaging and educational tour of the local flora, fauna and tropical forest ecology, with the chance to see a few species that are found nowhere else.

Your guide has more than 20 years of exploring this forest. Along with bird watching, wildlife spotting and plant identification, the day includes sightseeing along the Caribbean coast, a waterfall pool to cool down in and lunch at Hummingbird Heaven.
includes: Sightseeing along the Caribbean coastline, with stops for quick photos
Snacks at rest stops during the hike
One waterfall pool to cool down in
A local lunch with ice cream, fresh fruit and drinks at Hummingbird Heaven (changing room available)
Watching stingray feeding in a fishing village
bring: Walking shoes or water shoes with good grip
Swimwear for the cool-down (optional; wear it under your clothes, as changing is in the forest)
Change of clothes in case it rains in the forest
notes: Private tours: the hotel pickup time is flexible.
Private tours: an optional beach or waterfall stop after lunch.
Group tours may include other groups, families or individuals.

title: 1.5-Hour Rainforest Walk
summary: A shorter guided walk in the Main Ridge rainforest to two waterfalls, back at your hotel by 2pm.
body:
Enjoy a guided, low-intensity 1.5 km walk, there and back, through the Tobago Main Ridge Forest Reserve, the world’s oldest protected rainforest reserve, recognised by UNESCO. It is an engaging and educational tour of the local flora, fauna and tropical forest ecology, with the chance to see a few species that are found nowhere else.

Your guide has more than 20 years of exploring this forest, and the walk is a bird watching, wildlife and plant identification adventure from start to finish.
includes: Sightseeing along the Caribbean coastline, with stops for quick photos
bring: Walking shoes or water shoes with good grip
notes: Private tours: the hotel pickup time is flexible.
Group tours may include other groups, families or individuals.

title: Full-Day Island Tour
summary: A full day around Tobago: both coasts, a waterfall swim and a delicious local lunch.
body:
Get ready for an adventure-filled day exploring the greatest little island. We guide you through the hidden gems and iconic spots of Tobago, from stunning vistas to local legends, with each stop revealing a piece of what makes this place so extraordinary.

The day includes a waterfall visit with time to swim, and a delicious local lunch.
includes: Waterfall visit, with time to swim
notes: Private tours: the hotel pickup time is flexible.

title: Half-Day Island Tour
summary: Tobago’s highlights along both coasts in one morning, back at your hotel by 2pm.
body:
Get ready for an adventure-filled morning exploring the greatest little island. We guide you along the Caribbean and Atlantic coasts, with stops at the views and places that make Tobago so special.

This tour does not include lunch.
notes: Private tours: the hotel pickup time is flexible.

title: Pirate’s Bay & Pink Sand Bay
summary: Sightseeing to the fishing village of Charlotteville, then a boat to Pirate’s Bay and Pink Sand Bay for snorkelling and lunch.
body:
Prepare for an exciting journey to beautiful Pirate’s Bay, in the fishing village of Charlotteville. The day combines sightseeing along the Caribbean and Atlantic coasts with a boat excursion to the beaches.

The trip includes snorkelling, a visit to Pink Sand Bay, lunch and cold drinks.
includes: Sightseeing island tour to Pirate’s Bay, in the fishing village of Charlotteville
notes: Private tours: the hotel pickup time is flexible.

title: Buccoo Reef & Nylon Pool
summary: A one-of-a-kind boat tour with snorkelling at Buccoo Reef and a dip in the Nylon Pool.
body:
Get ready for a one-of-a-kind boat tour with snorkelling at Buccoo Reef and a bathe in the iconic Nylon Pool, where you will have the opportunity to exfoliate with the rejuvenating coral sand.

It is an educational trip as well as a relaxing one, and you are back at your hotel by 2pm.
includes: Time to lounge or swim in the Nylon Pool

title: 4×4 Off-Road Tour
summary: Secret waterfalls, wildlife and forest tracks, off the grid by Jeep.
body:
Explore some of the island’s best-kept-secret waterfalls, wildlife and forests, off the grid by Jeep.

This tour is not running at the moment. Send us a message if you would like to know when it is back.
